# Daysign

> Daysign is a small design and print studio based in Copenhagen (Denmark) and London (UK). We design custom, hand-drawn wedding stationery, invitations, signage, menus, place cards and complete visual identities for weddings, private celebrations and corporate events — and we organise printing and production. Design prices start from 2,500 DKK / £300.

- Website: https://daysign.studio/ (English) and https://daysign.studio/da/ (Danish)
- Email: hello@daysign.studio
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/itsdaysign/
- Locations: Copenhagen, Denmark and London, United Kingdom. We work with clients across Denmark, the UK and beyond.
- Languages: we design in any language — Danish, English, Russian and others, including bilingual invitations. We answer enquiries in English and Danish.
- Team: Polly Makarenkova (founder & designer), Haris Bahtijar (client relations & new business), Lisa Kucheruk (designer).

## What we design

- Weddings: save the dates, wedding invitations & RSVP cards, envelopes, welcome signs, wedding day schedules, seating charts & table plans, table numbers, place cards, menus, ceremony programmes, song sheets, bar and cake signs, thank-you cards, bilingual (Danish/English) stationery.
- Private celebrations: birthday and milestone birthday invitations and posters, konfirmation (invitations, menus, place cards, song sheets), christenings and naming days, baby showers, engagement parties, dinner parties, New Year's Eve parties, anniversaries, graduation parties, digital invitations.
- Companies and brands: julefrokost / Christmas party menus, place cards and event posters, company parties, product launches and store openings, pop-ups and brand activations, press kits and PR mailers, conference and event signage, brand dinners, invitations and tickets, posters and large-format print, business cards and brand stationery.
- Printing and production: quoted separately. We work with trusted print partners (printing, foil, embossing, die-cutting, large format) and produce small runs in-house. In London we find the right printer and guide the client.

## Prices (design fees, starting points)

- One Piece — one custom-designed piece (e.g. invitation, menu, seating chart, welcome sign, poster, illustration): from 2,500 DKK / £300.
- The Essentials — the key pieces of an event (creative direction, invitation or main piece, menu + 1 table piece, 1–2 signs, custom artwork, print-ready files): from 12,000 DKK / £1,400.
- The Full Day — the complete visual identity of an event (invitation suite, menus & table stationery, seating plan, up to 3 signs, place cards and small details): from 25,000 DKK / £2,900.
- Something Wild — custom projects that don't fit a package (launches, brand activations, unusual commissions): quoted individually.
- Every package includes 2 rounds of revisions; extra rounds at an hourly rate. Printing and production are quoted separately. Example: a typical Essentials project costs 12,000 DKK design + from 5,000 DKK production = from about 17,000 DKK in total.

## Timing

- Order at least 2 months before the event, ideally around 6 months.
- One piece usually takes 2 days to 1.5 weeks including revisions. Larger packages: timeline agreed before the project starts.
- Rush orders are often possible depending on the studio's schedule and may cost more.

## How to start a project

Send a short message via the form on https://daysign.studio/ or email hello@daysign.studio with the date, the type of event and roughly what you need. We reply with a recommended starting point and a quote.

## Frequently asked questions (English)

### How much do custom wedding invitations cost in Copenhagen?
Custom design at Daysign starts from 2,500 DKK for a single piece, like an invitation, menu or welcome sign. A small set of matching pieces (The Essentials) starts from 12,000 DKK, and a complete wedding identity (The Full Day) from 25,000 DKK. Printing and production are quoted separately.

### What does it cost in London?
The same packages in pounds: from £300 for one piece, from £1,400 for The Essentials and from £2,900 for The Full Day. Printing is quoted separately.

### How far in advance should I order wedding stationery?
At least 2 months before your event, ideally around 6 months. That leaves time for design, revisions and printing without rushing.

### Can you do a rush order?
Often, yes, depending on how busy the studio is. Rush projects may cost more, because your project moves to the front of the queue.

### How long does it take to design one piece?
Usually from 2 days to about a week and a half, including revisions. It depends on the concept and how detailed the artwork is. For bigger packages, we agree on the timeline before we start.

### How does the process work?
You tell us about your event. We propose a concept, design the pieces and refine them with you. Every package includes 2 rounds of revisions. Then we prepare print-ready files and can take care of printing for you.

### Is printing included in the price?
No. Prices are for design. Printing depends on quantity, paper and finishing, so we quote it separately once the scope is clear. We work with trusted print partners and also produce small runs in-house.

### Do you work in London and the UK?
Yes. Daysign works from Copenhagen and London. In London we find the right printer for your project and guide you on where and how to print it best.

### Can you design in Danish, English or other languages?
Yes, we can design in any language: Danish, English, Russian or whatever your guests speak, including bilingual invitations.

### What do you design for a julefrokost?
Most often a menu, place cards and an event poster. Everything is designed in one style, so the evening feels like your company's own party, not a template.

### What can you design for a konfirmation?
Invitations, a menu, place cards, a welcome sign and a song sheet (sanghæfte). Choose one piece or a full matching set.

### What kinds of events do you work on?
Weddings, birthdays, baby showers, christenings, konfirmation, dinner parties, company parties, julefrokost, product launches and brand events. If it's a day worth marking, we can design for it.

### How do I get started?
Send us a short message through the form on the website or email hello@daysign.studio. Tell us the date, the type of event and roughly what you need, and we'll recommend the right starting point.

## Ofte stillede spørgsmål (dansk)

### Hvad koster unikke bryllupsinvitationer i København?
Unikt design hos Daysign starter fra 2.500 kr. for ét design, fx en invitation, et menukort eller et velkomstskilt. Et lille samlet sæt (The Essentials) starter fra 12.000 kr., og en komplet visuel identitet til brylluppet (The Full Day) fra 25.000 kr. Tryk og produktion prissættes separat.

### Hvor lang tid i forvejen skal jeg bestille?
Mindst 2 måneder før jeres event, helst omkring et halvt år før. Så er der tid til design, rettelser og tryk uden stress.

### Kan I lave en hasteopgave?
Ofte, ja — afhængigt af studiets travlhed. Hasteopgaver kan koste mere, fordi jeres projekt rykker forrest i køen.

### Hvor lang tid tager ét design?
Typisk fra 2 dage til halvanden uge inklusive rettelser, afhængigt af konceptet og hvor detaljeret illustrationen er. Ved større pakker aftaler vi tidsplanen, før vi går i gang.

### Hvordan foregår processen?
I fortæller os om jeres event. Vi foreslår et koncept, designer delene og finpudser dem sammen med jer. Alle pakker inkluderer 2 rettelsesrunder. Derefter laver vi trykklare filer og kan sørge for trykket for jer.

### Er tryk inkluderet i prisen?
Nej. Priserne gælder design. Tryk afhænger af oplag, papir og efterbehandling, så det prissættes separat, når omfanget er klart. Vi samarbejder med faste trykkerier og laver også mindre oplag selv.

### Arbejder I også i London og Storbritannien?
Ja. Daysign arbejder fra København og London. I London finder vi det rette trykkeri til jeres projekt og guider jer i, hvor og hvordan det bedst trykkes.

### Kan I designe på dansk, engelsk eller andre sprog?
Ja, vi kan designe på alle sprog — dansk, engelsk, russisk eller det sprog, jeres gæster taler, også tosprogede invitationer.

### Hvad designer I til en julefrokost?
Oftest menukort, bordkort og en plakat til aftenen. Alt i samme stil, så festen føles som virksomhedens egen og ikke som en skabelon.

### Hvad kan I designe til en konfirmation?
Invitationer, menukort, bordkort, et velkomstskilt og et sanghæfte. Vælg ét design eller et helt samlet sæt.

### Hvilke events arbejder I med?
Bryllupper, fødselsdage, babyshowers, barnedåb, konfirmationer, middagsselskaber, firmafester, julefrokoster, produktlanceringer og brand events. Er det en dag, der skal markeres, kan vi designe til den.

### Hvordan kommer jeg i gang?
Send os en kort besked via formularen på siden eller skriv til hello@daysign.studio. Fortæl os dato, type event og cirka hvad I har brug for, så anbefaler vi det rette udgangspunkt.
